rationale: This plan creates an executive brief for the head of claims by aggregating headline metrics from the denial analysis (T2) and high-cost model results (T6), the two primary analytical outputs. The brief is structured with key findings, model results, limitations, and next steps to guide executive decision-making. Causal language is avoided to protect against misinterpretation of descriptive and comparative findings as causal claims. All four retrieved skills are applied through the write_report caveats: synthetic_data (disclose that the dataset is simulated), descriptive_only (clarify that denial and provider analyses are descriptive in nature), association_not_causation (distinguish observed group differences from causal effects), and no_operational_use (explicitly require clinical validation and governance review before any deployment of model scores). This comprehensive caveating protects the reader from common misinterpretations of analytical findings and model output.
